kiel-oldenburg-fehmarn-compact-coast.title: Kiel · Oldenburg and Fehmarn Compact Coast
kiel-oldenburg-fehmarn-compact-coast.slogan: A disciplined coast ride with a clear turnaround before it becomes a slog.
kiel-oldenburg-fehmarn-compact-coast.story: A disciplined coast ride with a clear turnaround before it becomes a slog. The best part sits around Lütjenburg gate, Oldenburg coast road, Fehmarn sound view, while the most useful town stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

scenicChapters.title: Hakone Turnpike and Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 22 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Hakone Turnpike and Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: For 80 km this is Hakone Turnpike and Skyline, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

hakone-skyline-and-fuji-lakes-and-izu-sk.story: 459 km round from Odawara - plan on about 8 h 49 of riding. On the way it passes Lake Ashi, Gotemba  window and Lake Yamanaka Fuji view. The climbs: Hakone Turnpike high road and Izu Skyline high section. It tops out at about 900 m. It is a high-mountain day.

legend-black-forest-panorama-route-b500-.story: curated scenic road. forest, waterfalls, mountain lakes. From Freudenstadt it runs 109 km to Waldshut-Tiengen; allow about 1 h 59 of riding. On the way it passes Triberg, Titisee-Neustadt and Todtnau. The highest point is about 1,250 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Black Forest Panorama Route B500 South
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 12 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
